title: Local compilation passed; resource failure retained
summary: The isolated build compiled, then exhausted local disk and memory during type checking. Cleared disposable webpack caches and retained the same payload for a local retry.

changes.detail: Preserved ENOSPC and native memory-allocation failure evidence; no application edits or hosted retry.

validation.name: Full build
validation.detail: Disk ENOSPC warning followed by type-worker Zone Allocation failure, exit 134.

validation.name: Recovery preservation
validation.detail: Only generated caches and redundant validation dependencies removed; source, old manifests, images, reports and deployment guards retained.
